pages.text: The Coolant Mixer makes $(l:nuclear/coolant)Coolant and Cryo Coolant$(/l). Piped into a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l), they move heat out of the core much faster than plain water, so the reactor can run at higher power.

It is a small multiblock: it needs a $(l)Cyber Frame on its right$(), seen from its front, against the open flange.$(br)$(li)$(l)Right-click$() the machine and a mini drone flies out and projects the frame where it goes.$(br)$(li)Hold sneak to place the frame against the machine itself.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: $(li)When the frame is there the machine assembles and opens, and both tanks show their levels.$(br)$(li)Until then it does nothing, but it keeps its contents. Breaking the frame folds the bench back and stops it; put a frame back and it opens again.

$(li)$(l)Water$(): Lapis Lazuli, $(l)Coolant$()$(br)$(li)$(l)Coolant$(): Blue Ice, $(l)Cryo Coolant$()$(br)$(li)Pipe the fluid in: water from a $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l), or Coolant to upgrade it to Cryo.$(br)$(li)Put the item in the slot by hand or with a hopper.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)Pipes and hoppers connect only to the machine's half of the bench: its left side, front, back or top.$(br)$(li)The left tank shows what goes in, the right one what comes out.$(br)$(li)The result is pushed into adjacent pipes and tanks by itself: pipe it to a $(l)Reactor Port$().
$(li)You can also fill an empty bucket from it: see $(l:nuclear/coolant)Coolant$(/l).$(br)$(li)It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.

$(li)$(l)Energy$(): 100 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Batch$(): 500 mB every 2 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)Tanks$(): 8,000 mB in, 8,000 mB out$(br)Without addons that is 15,000 mB a minute: more than even a Large reactor on Cryo Coolant uses.
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: Each tank holds one fluid at a time.$(br)$(li)$(l)In the Mixer$(): to switch from making Coolant to making Cryo Coolant, let the output tank empty first (pipe it away). Then feed it Coolant and Blue Ice.
pages.title: Switching coolants

pages.text: $(li)$(l)In the reactor$(): the coolant tank holds one kind at a time. Set the reactor's power to $(l)Off$() and click the small $(l)Dump coolant$() button under its coolant tank. The tank is poured away, then pipe in the new coolant. See $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l).
